details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with a JSON body containing the package name, the machine hostname, the install path, the working directory and the npm/node user agent, plus an X-Beacon-Package header. The same beacon is also fired when the package's index.js is imported. It collects no credentials, environment values, tokens or file contents, and the package README describes it as an authorized dependency-confusion test that only reports that it was installed. This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends a single HTTP POST of host metadata — package name, os.hostname(), install directory, working directory and npm/node user agent — to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header. index.js re-fires the same beacon when required. No credentials, tokens, environment values or file contents are read or transmitted.
